enchantment.shulkerstuff.deep_storage.de: [Not Yet Implemented] Adds extra rows to the shulker box, one more for each level of the enchantment.
enchantment.shulkerstuff.refill.desc: Refills your hand with a matching stack from the shulker box when the one you're holding runs out.
enchantment.shulkerstuff.vacuum.desc: Picked-up items that match something already in the shulker box go straight into it. Level II collects any item that fits.
enchantment.shulkerstuff.void.desc: Destroys picked-up items that match something already in the shulker box.
